map.办理财产、合同、遗嘱、继承等公证前，按标的额或件数估算公证费。: Before notarising property, contracts, wills or inheritance matters, estimate the fee from the claim amount or the number of items.

map.财产公证：≤20 万部分 1.2%（2400），20–50 万 1%（3000）: Property notarisation: 1.2% on the first ¥200,000, that is 2400, 1% on ¥200,000-500,000, that is 3000, 0.8% on ¥500,000-1,000,000, that is 4000, and 0.6% on ¥1,000,000-5,000,000, that is 6000; about ¥15,400 in total, with local scales differing slightly.
map.遗嘱公证基础费约 400 元/件，另加副本费（每份约 20 元）与翻译费（按字数: A will notarisation costs about ¥400 per item, plus copy fees of about ¥20 each and translation charged by the word.
map.不统一，由各省价格主管部门会同司法行政部门制定，各地标准有差异，实际以当地公证处: No. They are set by each province's pricing authority together with the judicial administration department, so scales differ; the rates published by the local notary office govern.

map.公证费估算（本页代码口径，分段累进+定额混合费率表，非单一「标的×费率」）：财产: Notarisation fee estimate (actual code on this page, a mixed bracket-progressive and flat rate table, not a single claim × rate): property inheritance is progressive by claim — 1.2% up to 200,000 (fixed 200 CNY when the claim ≤ 0), 2,400 + excess × 1% from 200,000–500,000, 5,400 + × 0.8% from 500,000–1,000,000, 9,400 + × 0.6% from 1,000,000–5,000,000, 33,400 + × 0.3% from 5,000,000–10,000,000, 48,400 + × 0.1% above 10,000,000; contracts: 200 CNY up to 20,000, then 0.8%/0.6%/0.4%/0.2% in four brackets (fixed 300 CNY when the claim ≤ 0); flat items: authorisation 200, birth/education 80, marriage 100, signature 150, copy 100, will 400, evidence preservation 1,000 CNY; enforceability at 0.3% of the claim (300 CNY without a claim); copy fee = (copies − 1) × 20, English translation 80 and other languages 120; total = base fee + copy fee + translation fee. Validation: no strict validation, invalid claim and copy count fall back to 0/1. Rule: no grading, with a note that local fees vary.
